en: What does sanitation mean?
Tell me about sanitation.
What is meant by sanitation?

answer_short.en: Sanitation means managing human waste safely and keeping the environment clean to prevent disease.
answer_short.shona: Sanitation zvinoreva kubata tsvina yevanhu zvakanaka uye kuchengeta nharaunda yakachena kuti chirwere chisapararire.

en: Why does sanitation matter?
How does sanitation help?
Why should we care about sanitation?

answer_short.en: Good sanitation helps stop cholera, typhoid, diarrhoea, and other diseases from spreading.
answer_short.shona: Sanitation yakanaka inobatsira kudzivirira korora, typhoid, manyoka, nezvimwe zvirwere kuti zvisapararire.

canonical_question.en: What diseases are caused by poor sanitation?
canonical_question.shona: Ndezvipi zvirwere zvinokonzerwa nesanitation isina kunaka?

en: What sicknesses come from bad sanitation?
Which diseases spread because of poor sanitation?
Can bad sanitation cause illness?
shona: Zvirwere zvipi zvinopararira nekuda kwesanitation isina kunaka?
Sanitation yakaipa inogona kukonzera kurwara here?

answer_short.en: Poor sanitation can cause diarrhoea, cholera, typhoid, and other waterborne diseases.
answer_short.shona: Sanitation isina kunaka inogona kukonzera manyoka, korora, typhoid, nezvimwe zvirwere zvemvura.

canonical_question.en: How does poor sanitation affect health?
canonical_question.shona: Sanitation isina kunaka inokanganisa utano sei?

en: What happens if sanitation is bad?
How does bad sanitation harm people?
What is the health impact of poor sanitation?
shona: Sanitation isina kunaka inokuvadza vanhu sei?

answer_short.en: Poor sanitation allows germs to spread into water, food, and homes, causing sickness.
answer_short.shona: Sanitation isina kunaka inoita kuti masimu apararire mumvura, muchikafu, nemudzimba zvichikonzera kurwara.

en: Use a toilet every time.
Wash hands after using the toilet.
Keep waste away from water and food.

answer_warning.en: Children are especially at risk when sanitation is poor.
answer_warning.shona: Vana ndivo vanonyanya kuva panjodzi kana sanitation isina kunaka.

canonical_question.en: Why should I use a toilet?

en: Why is using a toilet important?
Why not go outside?
What is the benefit of using a toilet?

answer_short.en: Using a toilet keeps waste away from water, food, and living areas.
answer_short.shona: Kushandisa chimbuzi kunochengeta tsvina kure nemvura, chikafu, nenzvimbo dzinogarwa.

answer_warning.en: Open defecation spreads disease through flies, rain, and contact.
answer_warning.shona: Kuzvibatsira panze kunoparadzira chirwere kuburikidza nemakonye, mvura yemvura, uye kubata.

en: Is going outside dangerous?
Why is open defecation bad?
Can open defecation make people sick?

answer_short.en: Yes. Open defecation spreads germs into the environment and can cause serious disease.
answer_short.shona: Hongu. Kuzvibatsira panze kunoparadzira masimu munharaunda uye kunogona kukonzera chirwere chakakomba.

en: Use a toilet or latrine every time.
Teach children to use safe toilet places.
Wash hands after using the toilet.
shona: Shandisai chimbuzi kana latrine nguva dzose.
Dzidzisai vana kushandisa nzvimbo dzakachengeteka dzekuzvibatsira.

answer_warning.en: Open defecation is dangerous for the whole community, especially children.
answer_warning.shona: Kuzvibatsira panze kune ngozi kunharaunda yose, kunyanya kuvana.

canonical_question.en: How can I keep my toilet clean?

en: How do I clean a latrine?
How should I keep the toilet hygienic?
What are toilet hygiene tips?

answer_short.en: Clean the toilet often and keep the area around it tidy and dry.
answer_short.shona: Chenesai chimbuzi nguva dzose uye chengetai nzvimbo yacho yakatsvinda uye yakaoma.

en: Clean the toilet regularly with water and a cleaning agent.
Keep the toilet covered when it is not in use.
Wash hands after use and dispose of waste properly.
shona: Chenesa chimbuzi nguva dzose nemvura nechinhu chekuchenesa.
Gezai maoko mushure mekushandisa uye rasai tsvina zvakanaka.

answer_warning.en: Do not leave waste near water sources or homes.
answer_warning.shona: Musasiye tsvina pedyo nemvura kana mudzimba.
